name: Liru Collagen Vitamin C Serum Orange 30ml Brightening Anti-Aging Face Serum for Glowing Skin
description:
Rejuvenate your skin with Liru Collagen Vitamin C Serum (Orange) — a powerful blend that brightens, firms, and revitalizes your complexion. Infused with Collagen and Vitamin C, this advanced serum boosts collagen production, reduces fine lines, and helps achieve a youthful glow. The antioxidant-rich formula neutralizes free radicals caused by UV exposure, supports skin elasticity, and evens out skin tone. With regular use, it restores your skin’s radiance, minimizes pigmentation, and enhances smoothness for a visibly brighter and firmer look.
Key Features:
 Infused with Collagen and Vitamin C for youthful, radiant skin
 Brightens dull complexion and reduces pigmentation
 Boosts collagen and elastin production for firmness
 Protects against UV damage and environmental stress
 Reduces fine lines and signs of aging
 Lightweight, fast-absorbing formula suitable for all skin types
How to Use:
 Cleanse your face thoroughly and pat dry
 Warm your hands slightly to enhance absorption
 Apply 3–5 drops evenly to face and neck, massaging gently for 2–3 minutes
 Follow with moisturizer or cream to lock in hydration
 Use twice daily for best results
Ingredients:
Water, 1,3-Propanediol, Glycerin, Sodium Hyaluronate, Polyacrylic Acid, Vitamin C, Betaine, Maltitol Glucan, PVM/MA Copolymer, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerol
Safety Information:
 For external use only
 Avoid direct contact with eyes
 Discontinue use if irritation occurs
 Store in a cool, dry place away from sunlight
Package Includes:
 1 × Liru Collagen Vitamin C Serum Orange (30ml)
